summary: Built and measured a capture backend that puts the workbench AND the cursor in one frame, and the pointer artifact the whole set was waiting on FLIPPED. ffmpeg gdigrab over the target window's desktop rectangle was measured against the Session 4 pilot's seven committed criteria -- the same s4-pilot-criteria.json, hashed and unmodified -- and met SIX of seven at the full bar: 10 of 10 consecutive clean runs (11 measured, 1 excluded as control-contaminated). C1 correlation 0.9989 with a decoy control at -0.0159; C3 dimension delta 0px including a deliberate resize; C4 anchor uncertainty 202ms with every cue inside the recording; C6 fifteen attempts with zero leaked processes, zero stray driver scripts and zero cleanup problems. C2 IS THE CRITERION THE BACKEND CHANGE IS ABOUT and it is scored against the mitigation the spec put in scope, because gdigrab reads the composited desktop and is NOT immune to an overlapping window -- measured at 25.39% leakage with the guard off. Four sub-measurements all hold: the detector fires at 0.7053 against a 0.5 bar (Session 4's Chromium occluder scored 0.441219 and FAILED that control with zero leakage, an instrument shortfall this session fixed with a borderless occluder), the weakness is demonstrated with the guard off so the guard is load-bearing rather than decorative, the guard refuses before starting, and it aborts mid-capture with a clean control. C7 IS THE ONE UNMET CRITERION, and only one of its three clauses: no-audio is MET structurally (-an, zero audio streams on all 11 recordings -- the clause OBS could never satisfy, since it muxes a silent track regardless) and single-source is MET, but 'never captures the screen' cannot be met by ANY backend that draws a cursor, because the cursor is composited by the desktop. That is the reason WGC cannot show one. The orchestrator measured it, wrote it up, named the unresolved question and STOPPED; the operator waived that clause and only that clause, narrowly, for gdigrab only. WINDOW-FOLLOW is abort-on-move, decided and falsified: moved 120,80px mid-capture aborted at 1947ms and kept the prefix; held still for 1800ms did not abort. Re-read-per-frame is unimplementable (gdigrab fixes its rectangle at stream open) and pinning was refused on the spec's own observe-only terms. ALSO SHIPPED: the long-form human-driven capture harness Session 7 owed and could not build (residual S7-R2) -- a detached start/stop/status daemon that records the SHIPPED VS Code window, never the Extension Development Host, writes nothing outside its run directory, never touches session-state.json or the orchestrator, and never focuses, pins or raises the window it records, with ai_router.speed_ramp wired in via --recording. THE POINTER ARTIFACT FLIPPED: s8-pointer-visibility-vscode.json is PASS with the control still FAILED -- a cursor-shaped mark, 20x26px, tip anchored at the hotspot, against 0.00000 change at five of six control probes. Session 7's FAIL artifact was left unedited, because this session's PASS is worth nothing without it.

C7's mechanism clause is WAIVED, not met, and the waiver is narrow: s8-operator-waiver.json covers that clause on the gdigrab backend only, does not cover C1-C6 or C7's other two clauses, does not apply to OBS, and is refused outright if the criteria file's digest changes, if an unmet criterion is not named in it, or if a re-measurement misses the ten-clean-run bar. Enforced by waiverCoverage() with seven falsifiers.

The long-form harness's happy path is proved on a 10.9-second smoke recording, not a full session. Its daemon lifecycle, ambiguity refusal, guard wiring and speed_ramp hand-off all ran, but the COMPRESSION path is unexercised because an 11-second window carries no framework timestamps to compress. Session 9's first real recording is what exercises it.

residuals.owner: any machine with a left-of-primary monitor
residuals.summary: The negative virtual-screen-origin branch is UNVERIFIED. gdigrab measures its offsets from the virtual desktop origin, which is negative when a monitor sits left of or above the primary. The code subtracts it; this machine reports (0,0), so the subtraction is a no-op here and the branch never ran. Getting it wrong yields a plausible video of the WRONG PIXELS rather than an error, which is why it is written down.

One display scale (100%) was exercised, so every C3 pass is a claim about that scale only. Identical to Session 4's residual and accepted for the same reason: changing the operator's live display scaling is an intrusive change to their working desktop. The resize variant tests the same dimension-blindness failure mode without touching display settings.

AVAILABILITY IS THE PRICE OF THIS BACKEND, and Session 9 will feel it. The occlusion guard refuses to start and aborts mid-capture whenever an unrelated window covers the rectangle; on the measurement machine three shipped VS Code windows were open and the harness refused to guess between them until --window-title-contains was added. A long tutorial recording interrupted by a toast loses its tail by design.

reason.specifics: SESSION 9 IS SET-TERMINAL and inherits the whole accounting: change-log.md, the Step 9 guidance review, and the UAT record for all SEVEN declared uatComponents. It also records the multi-module tutorial on top of what Session 8 built. WHAT IS NOW UNBLOCKED, and it is the point of the re-plan: the capture backend exists and is measured, the gate is OPEN for gdigrab under the operator's narrow waiver, the long-form harness is built, and the pointer-visibility artifact has flipped to PASS. The ordering ruling of 2026-08-16 is satisfied, so Session 9 may record. FIRST ACTION: run `node scripts/record-long-form.js start --set <slug> --session <N> [--window-title-contains ...]` before start_session and stop it after close_session. Expect to need the title filter -- more than one VS Code window open is normal and the harness refuses to guess. WHAT SESSION 9 MUST NOT DO: it must not re-litigate S7-R4 or S7-R5 (both operator-adjudicated), and it must not widen s8-operator-waiver.json -- the waiver covers C7's mechanism clause on gdigrab and nothing else, and waiverCoverage() will refuse it the moment a re-measurement fails anything else or misses the ten-clean-run bar. STAY ON THE COPILOT SEAT: Sessions 8 and 9 run on the operator's work computer, project-verify-type.txt already resolves COPILOT_CLI, and no DABBLER_* keys exist by design. ffmpeg 9.0, ffprobe and OBS Studio 32.2.1 were installed during Session 8 and are on PATH -- but a NEW SHELL is needed to see the PATH change, which cost this session a diagnostic detour. BUDGET: verification consumed four rounds. Spend the routed budget on verification and almost nothing else.
